svg.desc: ECDHE P-256 + RSA-2048 (legacy): 2,430 B client to server, 2,483 B server to client, 4,913 B total; X25519 + ECDSA P-256: 1,162 B client to server, 1,482 B server to client, 2,644 B total; X25519MLKEM768 + ECDSA P-256: 2,339 B client to server, 2,569 B server to client, 4,908 B total; X25519MLKEM768 + ML-DSA-65: 15,842 B client to server, 16,049 B server to client, 31,891 B total; ML-KEM-768 + ML-DSA-65 (pure PQC): 15,810 B client to server, 16,017 B server to client, 31,827 B total; SecP384r1MLKEM1024 + ML-DSA-87 (CNSA 2.0 level): 21,531 B client to server, 21,828 B server to client, 43,359 B total
